{{Top|leg}}
The '''Syvris shadowport''' was located on a [[moon/Legends|moon]] in the uninhabited [[Syvris system/Legends|Syvris system]] and became a favorite place of [[spice/Legends|spice]] [[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

It was operated by a former [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], [[Rance (pirate)/Legends|Rance]]. It was [[Raid on Syvris shadowport|destroyed]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].
